A generator keeps sump and ejector pumps running in a storm. It needs a gas line sized for it.
A gas pool heater draws more gas than most appliances in the house. We size the line for it and for everything already connected, so the furnace and water heater don't starve when it fires.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a New Gas Line
blocks.body: Distance from the meter, the route and the total load matter most. Outdoor kitchens, pool heaters and generators often need longer, larger lines. We plan the route and quote one flat price.

blocks.h2: Gas Line Installation Questions From Mokena Homeowners

items.q: Can you run a gas line to my backyard grill?
items.answer: Yes. We run a permanent line with a shutoff valve and a quick-connect at the grill.

items.q: Will my gas line handle a new appliance?
items.answer: We calculate the total load and check the size of your existing line. Sometimes it needs to be upsized.

items.q: Do I need a permit for a gas line?
items.answer: Most gas line work needs a permit. We handle it where required.

items.q: Can you install a gas line for a generator?
items.answer: Yes. Generators draw a lot of gas, so we size the line for the generator plus everything else on the system.

items.q: Can one gas line feed both a grill and a fire pit?
items.preview: Often, with the right size pipe and separate shutoffs.
items.answer: Often. We size the line for both appliances and put a shutoff valve at each one, so you can service one without turning off the other.

items.q: How much does gas line installation cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on length and the appliance. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the length of the run, the appliance and the route. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
